_comment: Hand-maintained rules. partHiddenBy: a part with this layer name is hidden when any worn item declares that slot code. zFallback: layer names missing from the game's zmap, drawn as the named layer instead. useEarlierId: when a hair/face name matches several items, keep only the one with the lowest id. listFirst: wearable ids shown first in their tab, in this order (none now). baseBody: the starter undergarments drawn as part of the body by gender, taken out of the Top and Bottom tabs (catalog.base). holds: weapons that have both a one-handed and a two-handed hold in the game files (the hammer and the slingshot, class 30), so the colour panel offers a Hold choice. stand2Only: weapons with no standing pose, drawn with the whole body in the two-handed pose. exclude: styles left out of the catalogue.
